description: A composite group made of three different kinds of image, all serving one argument: how the retained-austenite volume fraction Vγ was obtained. The first image is a rendered table with header row "Steel | T_A (MatCalc) | T_A (measured) | T_A (applied) | Ms (°C)" and five rows: S1 = 991 / 1062 / 1150 / 277; S2 = 929 / 1031 / 1150 / 274; S3 = 1177 / "broadened transition" / 1220 / 258; S4 = 1016 / 1067 / 1150 / 305, with a second S4 line 1250 / 310; S5 = 986 / 900 / 1150 / 331. Panel (a) is an XRD pattern of S1, Intensity (a.u.) 0–5000 versus 2θ = 30–100°, with peaks labelled (111)γ, (110)α, (200)γ, (200)α, (220)γ, (211)α, (311)γ and (220)α; the (200)γ reflection near 50° is boxed and an inset over 2θ = 47–53°, Intensity 0–2000 a.u., shows its grey peak area integrated under the label Iγ. Panel (b) plots MatCalc equilibrium phase fraction (log scale 1 to 0.001) against temperature for S1, with curves for bcc, κ-carbide, hcp, (Fe,M)xCy and AlN; a grey vertical band marks T_B 300 °C and T_B 350 °C and an arrow gives (1 − Vc) = 0.78. Together they give Vγ from integrated α/γ intensities combined with the carbide fraction.

subfigures.description: Rendered table headed Steel, T_A (MatCalc), T_A (measured), T_A (applied), Ms (°C); five steels S1–S5 with numeric values, S3's measured entry reading 'broadened transition', and S4 having two applied-T_A/Ms pairs (1150/305 and 1250/310).

XRD pattern of S1: Intensity (a.u.) 0–5000 vs 2θ = 30–100°, peaks labelled (111)γ, (110)α, (200)γ, (200)α, (220)γ, (211)α, (311)γ, (220)α; the (200)γ peak is boxed in pink and enlarged in an inset (2θ = 47–53°, Intensity 0–2000 a.u.) where the shaded grey peak area is labelled Iγ.

MatCalc-simulated equilibrium phase fraction of S1 (log y-axis 1 to 0.001) versus temperature (x-ticks 300, 500, 700); curves for bcc, κ-carbide, hcp, (Fe,M)xCy and AlN, a grey band between T_B 300 °C and T_B 350 °C, and an arrow labelled (1 − Vc) = 0.78.

observations.observation: The table has exactly five columns headed 'Steel', 'T_A (MatCalc)', 'T_A (measured)', 'T_A (applied)' and 'Ms (°C)'.
Five steels are tabulated as S1, S2, S3, S4 and S5.
S1 values are T_A(MatCalc) 991, T_A(measured) 1062, T_A(applied) 1150 and Ms 277 °C; S2 values are 929, 1031, 1150 and 274 °C.
S3 has T_A(MatCalc) 1177, T_A(applied) 1220 and Ms 258 °C, while its 'T_A (measured)' cell contains the words 'broadened transition' instead of a number.
S4 has T_A(MatCalc) 1016 and T_A(measured) 1067, but two applied-T_A/Ms pairs: 1150 with Ms 305 °C and 1250 with Ms 310 °C.
S5 has T_A(MatCalc) 986, T_A(measured) 900, T_A(applied) 1150 and the highest Ms of the table at 331 °C.
Panel (a) XRD peaks are labelled in order (111)γ, (110)α, (200)γ, (200)α, (220)γ, (211)α, (311)γ and (220)α across 2θ = 30–100°, i.e. austenite and ferrite/bcc reflections coexist.
The (200)γ reflection at about 50° 2θ is enclosed in a coloured box that feeds an inset covering 2θ = 47–53° with Intensity (a.u.) 0–2000, in which the grey-shaded peak area is labelled Iγ.
In panel (b) the phase-fraction axis is logarithmic from 1 down to 0.001, and the temperature axis carries ticks at 300, 500 and 700.
Panel (b) shows a solid bcc curve near the top of the fraction axis, a dashed κ-carbide curve around 0.2, and lower curves for hcp, (Fe,M)xCy and AlN.
A grey vertical band in panel (b) is annotated 'T_B: 300 °C' and 'T_B: 350 °C', and a right-pointing arrow beside it reads '(1 − Vc) = 0.78'.
The caption states the figure summarises T_A and Ms values and that Fig. 2 shows the method used to determine Vγ, with panel (a) being the integration of peak intensities of S1 at T_B = 350 °C.
The caption states panel (b) shows MatCalc-simulated equilibrium phase fractions of S1 steel as a function of temperature.

The citing text defines Vγ and Vc as volume fractions of retained austenite and carbides, Iα and Iγ as the integrated intensities of α and γ, and Rα, Rγ as theoretical relative intensities, and states the applied method for Vγ determination is summarised in Fig. 2.
